shortDescription: The SENSEX Index rose 564 points or 0.76 percent on Monday to close at 74859 points.Leading the gains are HCL Tech (2.54%), Sun Pharmaceuticals (2.05%) and ITC (1.96%).Top losers were Bharti Airtel (-3.27%), Adani Ports (-1.95%) and Bajaj Finance (-1.50%).
